ptr.title: time-priced-purchase → upg:q:23
ptr.comment: The price of “The Waiting Game” (quirks) grows with the time since the last quirks reset. The queue holds every reset that would zero it and buys at the moment the check measured. It starts whenever “The Waiting Game” (quirks) is unlocked and not owned.

ptr.title: challenge-attempt → ch:h:22
ptr.comment: “Descension” (hindrance) is ended by a reset of hindrance, solarity, quirks, subspace. The queue holds every one, enters, waits for the goal, finishes and lets go. It starts whenever “Descension” (hindrance) is unlocked, not completed, and no other challenge of its layer is running.

ptr.title: reset-requirement → reset:sg
ptr.comment: A super generators reset needs enough of your generators, which a reset of enhance, hindrance, solarity, quirks, space, super boosters, subspace, time zeroes. The queue holds every one, waits until the game allows the reset, resets and lets go. It starts whenever the layer is shown and has never been reset.
